symptoms: Check the fuel pressure using a gauge to determine if it is within the manufacturer's specified range.
Inspect the fuel pump, fuel filter, and fuel pressure regulator for any potential faults or obstructions.
Address any leaks in the fuel system that may be causing the pressure drop.
Reset the fault code after completing any necessary repairs to see if the issue has been resolved.
